notes: READ THE SCOPE CAREFULLY. This is the closest thing the District has to a general termination statute, but it is narrow: it protects service-contract and building-service employees when a contract or a building changes hands, by requiring a transition employment period, and Subchapter II adds COVID-era re-hire rights. The District has NO general severance-pay statute and NO mini-WARN mass-layoff notice statute - federal WARN (29 U.S.C. ss 2101-2109) does that work - and District employment is otherwise at-will. Final wages on discharge are governed by s 32-1303 in the wage chapter listed under Payroll/wages. If the corpus wants only general-application termination law, treat this topic as a gap instead.
